messages:
priya: quick q — we need a concrete cross-lang rulebook for retries/paging/auth propagation. current ad-hoc leads to bugs in go/ts parity.
alex: yes. first pass: define invariants rather than impls. e.g., idempotency hint + resume token shape + auth-metadata propagation.
ben: can you sketch the invariants? short bullets pls.
priya: sure. rough: 1) transport-layer retries must be optional and opt-in from surface; 2) surface exposes high-level helpers (auto-page, stream->page fallback) but never silently mutate auth headers; 3) resume token is an opaque base64 string across langs; 4) backoff & retry budget = surface default but configurable per-call.
laura: +1 on not mutating auth. real bug: streaming had ephemeral auth refresh that wasn't applied to resumed pages. we should mandate a callback for token refresh.
yves: for Go we already pass context; that should carry auth refresh. For TS/Py we need explicit `authProvider` callback on client creation.
ben: proposal for surface API (py):
```
class Client:
    def __init__(self, auth_provider: Callable[[],str]=None, retry_policy: Retry=None):
        ...
    def list_items(self, *, page_size=100, retry=None, resume_token=None):
        """Returns an iterator that yields items. Accepts a resume_token for resumption."""
```
Use explicit `auth_provider` so resumed pages call it fresh.
alex: TS counterpart:
```
export interface ClientOpts {
  auth?: () => Promise<string>;
  retry?: RetryOpts;
}
client.listItems({ pageSize: 100 }).autoPage(); // returns async iterable
```
Make `.autoPage()` semantics identical to py iterator.
priya: what about transport-level vs surface-level retries? e.g., TCP-level vs idempotent-op retries?
laura: transport (lower) should do connection-level retries only. surface is responsible for request-level idempotent retries with idempotency hints. otherwise semantics leak.
yves: agree. in go we already have a transport that retries idempotent idempotent-level GETs — we should restrict that to non-state-changing endpoints only and emit debug logs when it happens.
ben: pagination + retries: if a page fetch fails mid-stream, we should attempt surface retry using resume token when available. fallback rules: if server returns resume token, use it; else allow client to re-request with page token if provided by API.
priya: how to encode resume token shape? keep it strictly opaque: server decides, client only stores/transfers as bytes/base64. document max length.
alex: UX question: should default retry_policy be conservative (no retries) or optimistic (auto retries)? customers expect reliability but also deterministic billing.
laura: default = safe: enable idempotent retries for read/list ops with small budget (3 attempts) and short backoff. explicit opt-in for aggressive retries. document cost implications.
ben: need a small example demonstrating stream->paged fallback for TS:
```
for await (const chunk of client.streamResponses({q})) {
  // if stream aborts, client will attempt to fetch remaining results via autoPage using resume token
}
```
Make that behavior opt-out.
priya: telemetry: surface must emit events: retry.attempt, retry.giveup, resume.used, auth.refresh. these feed Optimize and Console. no PII.
yves: implementer's note: keep resume token in metadata only; don't try to parse. don't store in local logs unless redacted.
alex: testing matrix: we need unit tests across py/ts/go that assert parity on: 1) resume token roundtrip, 2) auth callback invoked on retry/resume, 3) retry budget honored, 4) stream->page fallback enabled/disabled.
laura: small operational item: add a compatibility section in model catalog docs for pagination/resume semantics per model adapter. some models may not support resume tokens.
ops-bot: deploy-check: CI job "sdk-surface-retry-paging-matrix" scheduled. @laura please add the job matrix. :white_check_mark:
ben: next steps: i'll draft a short RFC with these invariants and minimal API sketches for py/ts/go. invite reviewers from eng-runtime and eng-platform.
priya: thanks — aim for RFC by EOD Fri. i'll prototype auth callback pattern in python sample.
alex: I'll align TS async iterable shape; will add example in `docs/sdks/iterables.md`.
laura: ping me when RFC draft is up, I'll run the test suite scenarios.
yves: happy to pair on Go context semantics.
priya: cool. closing thread for now — post RFC link here when ready. :rocket:
